text.p: Retailer Woolworths Ltd said on Thursday it would restructure its management ahead of the retirement of managing director of supermarkets John Brunton.
Under the changes, to take effect from July 1, Roger Corbett, currently managing director of discount unit Big W, would become managing director, retail.
Corbett would be responsible for all trading divisions within the company and would report to chief executive officer Reg Clairs, Woolworths said in a statement.
Dick McMorron, currently deputy managing director, Big W, has been appointed chief general manager of Big W.
McMorron and recently appointed chief general manager supermarkets, Ian Cornell, would report to Corbett.
Woolworths said all other non-trading areas, including wholesaling unit Australian Independent Wholesalers Pty Ltd (AIW) would report directly to Clairs.
Brunton would remain as an executive director until the end of the company's annual general meeting in November 1997, assisting with the development of AIW and the company's expeort division.
